value.title: Role memory and the memory turn
value.summary: Roadmap 001 s07: role memory is one pij/memory ddoc per note with a generated INDEX.md, written one at a time; before pij compacts or closes a seat that holds a role, it asks the seat to write what it learned, and runs the compact or close after that turn.

sections.name: summary
sections.value: Delivers req-09; builds c-memory-hook. Memory is never capped or pruned. The hand-written roles already have memory/ folders and INDEX.md files (kept by the import's adopt mode, #122); this plan's index generation must keep their existing lines.

sections.name: goals
value: Roadmap 001 s07: role memory is one pij/memory ddoc per note with a generated INDEX.md, written one at a time; before pij compacts or closes a seat that holds a role, it asks the seat to write what it learned, and runs the compact or close after that turn.

sections.name: non_goals
value: Anything another roadmap step owns; see roadmap 001.

value.claim: Write a note. `pij directory memory add <role> --title --tags --hook --body|--body-file` writes `roles/<id>/memory/<yyyy-mm-dd>-<slug>.dd.json` (pij/memory) through the writer and regenerates `memory/INDEX.md` with one line per note, keeping lines for existing hand-written notes.

The memory turn. Before `pij compact` or `pij close` of a seat that holds a role, pij delivers a memory prompt to that seat and holds the compact or close until that turn ends (or a bounded wait passes, after which it proceeds and says so). A seat holding no role is compacted or closed directly.
Read. `pij directory memory <role>` prints the INDEX and `--note <slug>` one note; nothing is ever deleted.

Cost (AGENTS.md, resource cost is a correctness property). One writer commit per note. The memory turn is one delivery before a compact or close; no timer or poll (the hold waits on the turn-end event the daemon already sees).

Docs and states. In this PR: roadmap s07 goes to complete (plan cell docs/plans/201-role-memory); req-09 goes to shipped; c-memory-hook goes to shipped. docs/how/pij-rs-api.md documents new verbs and refusals; the skill's verb coverage tables carry them; `just ddocs-check` and `ddocs validate` on the project docs pass; the PR body has a `Delivers:` line.

sections.name: research_context
sections.value: Code to read first: the compact and close paths (crates/daemon/src/http/lifecycle.rs; compact handling), turn-boundary events (state working/idle), crates/daemon/src/community/. No migration expected; if one is needed, ask pm-001 for a number.

value.risk: Two lanes edit the same CLI wiring or skill files.
value.mitigation: Rebase onto main before the PR; small diffs at the seam; pm-001 orders merges.

sections.name: execution_guardrails
value: Tests use scratch repos and a private daemon; never the live governance branch or the prod daemon.
Builds: your own target or `just shared-build`; CARGO_INCREMENTAL=0; -p scoping; stop under 25 GB free.
No `git add -A`, no `--no-verify`; no node_modules, never symlinked (C25); TS proof is CI on the exact head.
Shared seams (crates/cli wiring, skills/pij): rebase onto main before the PR and keep edits minimal; don't fork the seam.
One push per review round; no pushes after the PR is out for verdicts unless a verdict asks.
